First, evaluate the expression inside the parentheses:  
\( \text{False or False or True} \)  

- Left to right:  
  \( \text{False or False} = \text{False} \)  
  \( \text{False or True} = \text{True} \)  

So \( \text{False or False or True} = \text{True} \).  

Now apply the NOT:  
\( \text{not (True)} = \text{False} \)  

Final answer: false
